title: Acute Abdomen in Adults- a Prospective Study on Emergency Department Admissions
brief_summary: This is a non-randomized, prospective, population-based, single-center study designed to evaluate conditions resulting emergency admission in patients with abdominal pain. Furthermore, we are interested in how many patients are discharged with "non-specific abdominal pain" but later readmitted and diagnosed with a specific diagnosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

All adult patients with abdominal pain.

Exclusion Criteria:

Under the age of 18 years
study_population: the adult patients with abdominal pain admitted to the emergency department are included. One thousand patients from Tampere district will be chosen for analysis.
